name: Push past overhang
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 4 ticks after Start.
Box 0: 4 cells, starting at (0, 4, 1) through (3, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.
Ticks 2–3 (each tick): Player moves 1 down.
Tick 4: Player disappears.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
